claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black keyboard/synth with Yamaha branding text visible, but no proof of working condition, sound, or suitability for children.
Witness report identifies Yamaha branding text in Photo 2; no Casio branding is reported as visible.

risks.risk: Exact model is unknown, so features/specs (number of keys, built-in sounds, connectivity like USB/MIDI) and typical used value can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the bottom panel or back) and the full control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-model used keyboard with worst-case feature set and no confirmed connectivity.

risks.risk: Not confirmed to power on and function (sound output, speakers, keys, sliders/buttons, MIDI/USB).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, playing several keys, and demonstrating at least one button/slider change plus speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-tested / possibly non-working until proven.

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty: key wear, scratches/dents, missing knobs/buttons, or repairs are not documented.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the entire keybed (top and sides), all control knobs/buttons/slider ends, and the corners/underside.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst visible-wear scenario (assume average-to-worn used condition) until specific damage is shown.

risks.risk: Power adapter/cord (or battery compartment) may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of the included power adapter/cord (model/ratings visible) and a photo of the battery compartment if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/unknown power accessories (assume buyer must source adapter).

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (stand, sustain pedal, cables).
risks.proof: Photos showing everything included laid out: sustain pedal, stand, USB/MIDI cables, manuals.
risks.if_unproven: Price without accessories (worst case: only the keyboard).

risks.risk: Serial number/production year and warranty status unknown, affecting value and authenticity confidence.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the serial number/production label and any warranty/receipt documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price without warranty/age certainty (worst case: older unit).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the bottom/back label showing exact Yamaha model number and serial number.
Video: power on + audible sound test (play keys) + demonstrate a few buttons/sliders working.
Close-up photos of every control area (buttons/knobs/slider tops and ends) to confirm nothing is missing/broken.
Photo of the power adapter/cord included (or confirm battery-powered model and show battery compartment).
Photos of included accessories (sustain pedal, stand, cables/manuals) laid out.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a Yamaha keyboard (brand text visible), but key working status, exact model, and accessories are not proven. I will price at the worst-case assumption for an untested/unknown-model used keyboard until the missing proof is provided.
